dataSafety.panel.explainer: Everything in {appName} is stored in this browser, on this device. There is no account and no server — nothing is uploaded. Backups (export files) are the way to protect your data and move it to another device.
dataSafety.panel.unavailable: Storage details aren't available in this browser. Backups are still your safety net.
dataSafety.meter.warn: Worth a look — storage is filling up
dataSafety.meter.crit: Action needed — storage is almost full
dataSafety.meter.unknown: Your browser doesn't report storage use here.
dataSafety.persistence.heading: Keeping your data
dataSafety.persistence.granted: Protected — this browser is keeping app data
dataSafety.persistence.denied: Not protected — this browser may clear app data
dataSafety.persistence.unsupported: This browser doesn't offer extra protection
dataSafety.persistence.error: This browser wouldn't say. Backups are your safety net.

dataSafety.backup.doneSafe: Backup saved to your downloads. Keep it somewhere safe.
dataSafety.backup.error: Couldn't save the backup. Free up space and try again.
dataSafety.backup.empty: Nothing to back up yet — once you add tasks, save a backup here.
dataSafety.snapshots.heading: Snapshots
dataSafety.snapshots.empty: Snapshots are automatic safety copies made before big changes (like an import). You'll see up to three here.
dataSafety.snapshots.downloadFailed: Couldn't download that snapshot. Nothing was changed.
dataSafety.danger.heading: Danger zone
dataSafety.danger.body: This permanently deletes every task, list and setting from this browser. Export a backup first if you might want this data again.
dataSafety.onboarding.h1: Your data lives in this browser
dataSafety.onboarding.body1: {appName} stores your tasks on this device, in this browser. There is no account and no server — nothing you type is uploaded anywhere.
dataSafety.onboarding.body2: One important thing: on iPhones and iPads, Safari can delete a website's data after 7 days if you don't visit the site. That can include your tasks.
dataSafety.onboarding.body3: Your protection is backups. Every so often, tap Back up now in Settings → Storage & back up to save a backup file, and keep that file somewhere safe. If the browser ever clears this app's data, you can restore everything from that file.
dataSafety.onboarding.howBody: A backup is a single .json file containing all your tasks and lists. It's created entirely on your device and saved to your downloads. Nothing is sent anywhere. To restore, use Import in Settings → Storage & back up.
dataSafety.onboarding.footer: You'll find the storage and backup controls any time in Settings.
dataSafety.banner.backup.titleDays: It's been {N} days since your last backup.
dataSafety.banner.backup.body: A backup file is your safety net — browsers (especially Safari on iPhone and iPad, which can remove website data after 7 days) can clear this app's data. Save a backup now and keep it somewhere safe.
dataSafety.banner.longAbsence.title: Welcome back — it's been {N} days.
dataSafety.banner.longAbsence.body: On iPhones and iPads, Safari can remove website data after 7 days without visits, so it's a good habit to back up. {lastBackupLine}
dataSafety.banner.shrunken.title: Your data looks smaller than it was
dataSafety.banner.shrunken.body: {pct}% of your tasks and lists are gone from this browser — that usually means browser data was cleared. If you have a backup, import it now to get everything back.
dataSafety.banner.quotaWarn.title: Storage is filling up
dataSafety.banner.quotaWarn.body: Storage for {appName} is {pct}% full. If it fills up, new tasks can't be saved. Export a backup and delete things you no longer need.
dataSafety.banner.persistDenied.title: Keeping your data is limited
dataSafety.banner.persistDenied.body: This browser hasn't granted extra protection for {appName}'s data. On iPhones and iPads, Safari can remove website data after 7 days — backups are your safety net.
dataSafety.banner.quotaPending.titleOne: {N} change is waiting to be saved.
dataSafety.banner.quotaPending.titleMany: {N} changes are waiting to be saved.
dataSafety.banner.quotaPending.body: Nothing has been lost — your change is waiting and will be saved as soon as there's space.
dataSafety.quota.title: Not enough storage space
dataSafety.quota.body: Your change couldn't be saved because this browser's storage for {appName} is full. Nothing has been lost — your change is waiting and will be saved as soon as there's space.
dataSafety.quota.body2: Free up space, or export a backup first so nothing is at risk.
dataSafety.private.title: This looks like private browsing
dataSafety.private.body: In private or incognito windows, browsers delete {appName}'s data when the window closes. Anything you add here may not be there next time.
dataSafety.private.body2: Export a backup before you close this window to keep your tasks.
dataSafety.deleteAll.title: Delete all data from this browser?
dataSafety.deleteAll.body: This permanently deletes {tasks} tasks, {lists} lists and all settings from this browser. It cannot be undone.
dataSafety.deleteAll.body2: If you might want this data later, export a backup first.
dataSafety.deleteAll.done: All data deleted from this browser.
dataSafety.deleteAll.failed: Couldn't delete all data. Nothing was removed.
dataSafety.recovery.body: This browser's stored data for {appName} is gone or was reduced. That usually means browser data was cleared — or, on iPhones and iPads, that Safari removed the app's data after 7 days without a visit.
dataSafety.recovery.lastBackup: Your last backup was {N} days ago ({date}). You can restore everything from that file.
dataSafety.recovery.lastBackupOne: Your last backup was 1 day ago ({date}). You can restore everything from that file.
dataSafety.recovery.lastBackupToday: Your last backup was today ({date}). You can restore everything from that file.
dataSafety.recovery.neverBackup: You haven't backed up before, so there may be nothing to restore from.
dataSafety.recovery.startFreshConfirm: Starting fresh creates a new empty task list. Anything not restored from a backup is gone.
dataSafety.import.partial: Some records couldn't be read and were left out.
dataSafety.import.recoveryOffer: The damaged records can be saved as a recovery file.
dataSafety.import.error.newer: This backup was made by a newer version of {appName}. Update the app and try again.
dataSafety.import.error.tooLarge: This file is too large to be a backup.
dataSafety.import.error.badJson: This file can't be read as a backup — it may be damaged.
dataSafety.import.error.generic: This backup couldn't be read. Nothing was changed.
dataSafety.import.error.nothing: Nothing in this file could be imported. Nothing was changed. The damaged records can be saved as a recovery file.
dataSafety.import.error.quota: There isn't enough space to import this backup. Free up space and try again.
dataSafety.import.error.malicious: This file isn't safe to import. Nothing was changed.
dataSafety.import.error.limits: This backup has more records than this app can import.
dataSafety.import.confirm.title: Replace everything with this backup?
dataSafety.import.confirm.body: This backup contains {tasks} tasks in {lists} lists (exported {date}).
dataSafety.import.confirm.bodyNoDate: This backup contains {tasks} tasks in {lists} lists.
dataSafety.import.confirm.body2: Importing will replace the data currently in this browser: {currentTasks} tasks in {currentLists} lists will be removed and replaced by the backup, and your settings are replaced too — theme and language come from the backup file.
dataSafety.import.confirm.body3: Before importing, {appName} saves a snapshot of your current data. It lives in Settings → Storage & back up → Snapshots, where you can restore it in one tap or download it as a file.
dataSafety.import.confirm.body4: Importing an older backup can bring back tasks and lists you deleted after that backup was made.
dataSafety.import.confirm.quarantined: {N} damaged records will be left out. You can download a recovery file afterwards.
dataSafety.import.done.message: Import complete. Your previous data is saved as a snapshot.
dataSafety.import.failed.recoverable: Nothing was changed. Your data is exactly as it was.
dataSafety.import.failed.snapshotFirst: Your backup couldn't be imported because the safety snapshot failed. Nothing was changed.
dataSafety.restore.title: Replace everything with the snapshot from {date}?
dataSafety.restore.body: This snapshot is a copy of everything in this browser from {date}.
dataSafety.restore.body2: Importing will replace the data currently in this browser: {currentTasks} tasks in {currentLists} lists will be removed and replaced by the snapshot.
dataSafety.restore.missing: That snapshot is no longer available. Nothing was changed.
